summary: Verified BILLING-UI-1 v5 + STRIPE-CONFIG-1 v4 spec gaps. All 4 pytest acceptance tests pass (access-grant-only-on-webhook, webhook idempotency, proration preview graceful degradation, sync idempotency). All 8 additional endpoint contract tests pass. Pricing page tier cards, Settings->Billing backup-card note (data-testid billing-backup-card-note present with correct copy), Signup family+participant block all verified. Klarna disabled at checkout (endpoint returns Stripe URL, no 5xx). No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint /api/payments/proration-preview relies on Pydantic body validation happening before auth dependency, so an unauthenticated request with empty body returns 422 instead of 401. Not a real bug (401 is returned once body is valid), but confusing. Consider explicitly requiring auth before body parsing if the spec wants strict 401 ordering.

GET /api/payments/prices took >30s on cold call from the external URL (probably Stripe list latency + no cache warm). The 10-min cache mitigates repeat cost, but consider async warm-up on startup or serve last cached snapshot while refreshing.
